native.overlays: Existing World reference UI held constant; report overlay scope separately.
native.shadowPolicy: Resolved Medium budgets unchanged; count actual expanded casters and parts, not source roots.

snapshotPair.entityIdentity: EntityId((uint)(i+1),1), i=0..N-1. Current generation increments to 2 on i%10==0 only in the separate GenerationChurn CPU cohort.
snapshotPair.ownership: Independent immutable PresentationSnapshot instances; preserve arrays and reader lifetime. ReferenceSnapshotHistory creates correspondence before timing.

placement.hash: unchecked uint h=(uint)i+2026; h^=h>>16; h*=0x7feb352d; h^=h>>15; h*=0x846ca68b; h^=h>>16
placement.lowVisibility: For i%10!=0 add (4000,0,0) to BOTH states. This is a render-only off-frustum control, not gameplay geography.
placement.geometry: One resolved compiled crate mesh/LOD and material binding for every synthetic root, no skin/mechanical expansion or wind. Use existing production vertex and 112-byte instance streams. Record resolved mesh/material identities and verify one compatible visible batch per pass, subject to current shadow budgets.
placement.caveat: High/Low name the intended distribution, not an invented exact visible count. Retain actual candidates, visible roots and expanded parts for every frame.

cpu.churn: GenerationChurn follows snapshotPair. OneRemovalOneAddition changes current IDs to 2..N+1, keeps N roots, preserves generation-aware matching.
cpu.separation: Measure correspondence Update/preparation, capacity growth and retained bytes separately from repeated per-index and by-entity interpolation. Null-context/CPU results never acquire GPU milliseconds.

isolation.submission: Current indexed instancing is the baseline. Historical/diagnostic alternatives require an explicitly named same-work reference; no unimplemented legacy-mode flag is assumed.
isolation.staticMemory: Default behavior versus FORGELINE_STATIC_BUFFER_UPLOAD_FALLBACK=1, captured at process creation; restore unset afterwards.
isolation.correspondence: Compare a named parent build or test-only reference with identical populated histories; never first-snapshot-only work.
isolation.combined: Only after each isolated comparison and serial integration.

metrics.cpu: Prepare, RenderFrame/recording, Present/reuse waits and caller allocation scopes separately. Existing native CPU bracket is RenderFrame, not simulation time.
metrics.gpu: Actual direct-queue frequency and distinct completed fence IDs. Drain warmup and final results outside timing. Latest-completion diagnostics may skip completions; preserve actual sample counts and null unavailable scopes.
metrics.counts: Source roots, expanded mechanical parts, visible/candidate roots, compatible batches/draws and main/shadow submissions separately.
metrics.memory: Instance traffic/capacity, logical texture/mesh bytes, native upload arena destination/staging bytes, peaks/pressure waits and DXGI usage are distinct, overlapping categories.
metrics.limits: SkinUploadBytes currently reports retained skin-buffer bytes; do not label it per-frame traffic. Missing counters/UMA query results stay explicitly unavailable and return to the serial owner if a shared API is needed.
metrics.statistics: Preserve per-frame chronology plus mean/p50/p95/p99 and allocation distributions. Existing native collector lower-median/nearest-rank definitions remain unchanged.

acceptance.performanceGate: Existing opt-in 15% comparator, no automatic baseline adoption or universal CI threshold.
acceptance.images: Existing exact repeated readbacks and reviewed cross-run pixel comparator. Structural equality is not human art acceptance.
acceptance.unavailable: WARP/null contexts, missing GPU samples, mismatched source/payload/hardware/settings or unimplemented fixture controls cannot qualify as hardware performance.
acceptance.implementation: This file defines the future scaling matrix. Current executable workloads are Representative/Vehicles1000; NativeScalingQualification implements and validates the new fixture within its exact scope.
